method: Own exact etch Scharr dx,-drow; 4 native-pixel sigma Gaussian average of gradient SECOND MOMENTS only; RG encode unoriented principal axis as cos(2theta),sin(2theta); A encodes directional coherence and source alpha. Bilinear output resize. B is neutral spacing. Used for anisotropic reflection, not diffraction or relief.
limitation: Optical orientation inferred from own die. Physical angular width calibrated visually to supplied Japanese photograph, not measured.
